messages:
Priya (Support): FYI - customer ACME Mobile reporting intermittent 401s + large tail latency. They say requests show as routed to nearest pop instead of EU. Sample header they sent below. Can someone triage?

ACME Mobile (customer): Hey team — after SDK v2.4.1 rollout we started seeing ~3% 401s and billing showing tokens in us-west. SDK logs show region set to \"e\" in some requests. Not sure how that happened.

Priya (Support): Reproduced from their curl: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" -H "x-client-region: e" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

Leo (Eng-SRE): interesting — router treats unknown/short region values as missing and falls back to nearest POP. If the auth token has claims for another region we can end up cross-region which causes 401s and latency. Do we have an example request-id?

ACME Mobile (customer): request-id: rq_0b3f9c8a, sample SDK log attached: `INFO region=\"e\"` then `WARN routing fallback -> us-west-1`

Sam (Runtime): can you paste the auth service token claims for rq_0b3f9c8a (no full token, just decoded header+claims)? I want to see `region` claim.

Priya (Support): Token claims (redacted): `{"sub":"acct_123","region":"eu-west-1","exp":1700000000}` — so token region SHOULD be eu-west-1. But header was `e`.

Leo (Eng-SRE): aha. That mismatch explains 401: router forwarded to us-west due to header value `e`, token validation then failed because the token audience/issuer is eu-west. Router should validate header format/length first.

Carla (DevEx): Do we know which SDK code path produces `e`? Mobile team had a change to compress region flags for URL length concerns in 2.4.1. Maybe a bug in split/join.

ACME Mobile (customer): added repro steps — Android emulator, app hits /set-region with payload `{"region":"eu-west-1"}` then subsequent requests intermittently have `x-client-region: e` (not `eu` or `eu-west-1`). Happens more after app background/resume.

Sam (Runtime): Could be a string truncation when persisting to SharedPreferences. Need a repro harness. Priya can you ask them to run this minimal flow and paste SDK debug log around region assignment? Something like:
```
// Android pseudocode
prefs.putString("last_region", region)
// later
val r = prefs.getString("last_region", "")
headers.put("x-client-region", r.substring(0, Math.min(r.length, 1))) // <--- bug
```

Priya (Support): I asked for full debug paste. Meanwhile telemetry shows a spike in cross-region hops for mobile SDK clients starting 2026-01-15 09:12 UTC. Billing shows token usage in us-west for ACME account during that window. Customer unhappy about extra latency + cost.

Leo (Eng-SRE): Quick mitigation — router can reject region values shorter than 2 chars and fall back to token-region claim; I'll open a fast patch to prefer token-region when header fails validation. Sam can you review?

Sam (Runtime): +1. Also suggest metric/alert for header-length anomalies. I'll make a small change to token-first fallback and instrument counts.

Carla (DevEx): For SDK: I'll open PR to validate before sending and avoid truncation on SharedPrefs. We should release a patch build (2.4.2) and recommend customers to update.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: runtime/router region-header-validation v0.1 -> canary in us-west-1 (5% traffic).

Leo (Eng-SRE): Canary looks healthy for 20m. No regressions. Once canary passes we'll roll to all-edge in 15m.

Priya (Support): Sent ACME Mobile a temporary workaround: clear app storage on resume and force region header to empty so router uses token-region. They confirmed immediate drop in 401s.

ACME Mobile (customer): Workaround helped. Thanks. They'll test 2.4.2 when available.

Sam (Runtime): Patch merged to master: router now treats header values <2 chars as invalid, uses token-region instead, emits metric `router.region_header_invalid`.

Carla (DevEx): SDK fix PR opened, small change to SharedPrefs write/read and added unit test. Will cut 2.4.2 once QA signs off.

Priya (Support): Marking this as escalated -> resolved for now. Will follow up post SDK release to confirm billing corrections and close ticket.

Leo (Eng-SRE): Follow-up: add alert for cross-region token mismatch rate > 0.25% to catch similar regressions earlier.

Priya (Support): thanks all :thumbsup:
